title: Element family definition
description: One family of XML or JSON elements (BPMN, Zeebe, DMN, form-js components): its elements, their attributes, children, placement and traits. Used by every file in spec/elements/. Data only; validation and serialisation logic stay in code.

family.description: Family name, lower case: `bpmn`, `zeebe`, `dmn`, `form`. Also the file name and the prefix of generated identifiers.

namespace.description: XML namespace of the family's elements. Absent for non-XML families such as form.

source.description: Attribution: the schema, product and version the definitions are taken from.

traits.description: The family's trait vocabulary. An element may only list traits declared here (the generator checks it). A trait is a free-form flag a consumer queries, e.g. `keyed`.

elements.description: The family's elements, in a stable order consumers may rely on (e.g. for messages).

name.description: Element name: the XML local name (`taskDefinition`) or the form-js `type` (`textfield`). Unique within the family.

extends.description: Name of the element this one extends; it inherits that element's attributes, children and allowedIn. Traits are not inherited: list them on every element they hold for. Unqualified (`name`) for the same family or `family:name` for another.

abstract.description: True for a base type that is never instantiated, only extended.

allowedIn.description: Parent constraint: the element names (`name` or `family:name`) this element may appear directly inside. Absent means unconstrained. Zeebe placement uses it with BPMN parents, e.g. `taskDefinition` in `bpmn:serviceTask`.

traits.description: Traits from the family's `traits` vocabulary that hold for this element.

type.description: Value type. `expression` is a FEEL expression, `id` declares an id, `idref` references one, `enum` needs `values`.

values.description: The allowed values; required for (and only for) `enum`.

default.description: Value assumed when the attribute is absent; matches `type`.

required.description: True when the attribute must be present. Default false.

multiplicity.description: How often the child occurs: `1` exactly once, `0..1` optional, `0..*` any number, `1..*` at least once. Default `0..*`.
